hints.content: Each year, the cumulative number of cars that have crossed the Golden Gate Bridge grows by a constant **amount**, so it is best to use a linear function.
A linear function best models this relationship.

question.content:
Every year $39$ million cars cross the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco.

**Which kind of function best models the relationship between time and the cumulative number of cars that have crossed the Golden Gate Bridge?**
